title: Convert a public PIM Manager environment to private
purpose: Converts a public (external) PIM Manager environment to private (internal-only): it captures the live PIM Manager and jobs, deletes and recreates the Container Apps environment internal-only on the same subnet and workspace, restores the apps from the capture and compares them, repairs what is keyed to the new identities, attaches sign-in and publishes the private DNS zone for the new address. Data is kept. It plans unless -Apply is given.
whenToRun: Once, to convert a public environment to private (the 'rebuild' route of the conversion guide), after the registry has a private endpoint and the network is prepared. Plan a maintenance window (the delete of a VNet-integrated environment takes 15-30 minutes). It runs on Windows (the capture protects secret values with Windows DPAPI). It is part of the PIM Manager release package and runs Rebuild-PimEnvExternal.ps1 next to it: run it from the package folder that Install-Invardia or the guided install downloaded (signed), or, for Community, from the public repository at the release tag.

runAs.name: Owner, or Contributor + User Access Administrator
runAs.scope: the PIM resource group (role re-grants: their original scopes)
runAs.why: Deletes and recreates the Container Apps environment, the PIM Manager and the jobs, and grants the new system identities the Azure roles the old ones had. Signed in through the browser or the Invardia Support app session (no Azure CLI, no modules).

runAs.name: Application Administrator (or owner of the PIM Manager's sign-in app)
runAs.scope: the PIM Manager's sign-in app registration
runAs.why: Sign-in (Easy Auth) is attached to the new private address; the reply address is added to the app registration.

runAs.name: Optional: an identity in the SQL admin group (grp-pim-sql-admins) with a certificate (-SqlAdminClientId + -SqlAdminCertThumbprint)
runAs.why: Repairs the database users of the recreated apps. Without it the Azure roles are still repaired and the script says the database half is owed.

runAs.name: Optional: Privileged Role Administrator (with -HostingAccessTenantId)
runAs.why: Re-grants the new identities' Microsoft Graph application permissions (Initialize-PimHostingAccess.ps1).

changes.object: the capture of the live environment, the PIM Manager and every job (secret values DPAPI-protected) in -CaptureDir
changes.why: The rebuild restores from it and resumes from it; files holding secret values are shredded when the rebuild completes.
changes.undo: Delete the capture folder once the rebuild has completed.

changes.object: the Container Apps jobs, the PIM Manager app and the public Container Apps environment (only with -Apply)
changes.why: The internal/external setting of a Container Apps environment cannot be changed in place.
changes.undo: Re-run with -ResumeFromCapture -CaptureDir <the printed folder>; or rebuild public again with Rebuild-PimEnvExternal.ps1.

changes.object: the internal-only Container Apps environment on the same subnet and workspace, the PIM Manager (ingress internal first) and every job, from the capture
changes.why: The conversion itself; the restore is compared with the capture.
changes.undo: Rebuild-PimEnvExternal.ps1 -Apply (the same tool in the other direction).

changes.object: each recreated app's and job's new system identity gets the Azure role assignments its old identity had
changes.permission: the same Azure roles the old identity held (recorded before the delete)
changes.scope: the scopes recorded before the delete
changes.why: A recreated app gets a new identity.
changes.undo: Remove the role assignments of the new identities.

changes.object: the database users of the recreated apps, created again from the new identities with their recorded roles (only with a SQL admin credential)
changes.why: Without the repair the PIM Manager cannot sign in to SQL.
changes.undo: None needed; the users match the live identities.

changes.target: Entra ID and the PIM Manager
changes.object: sign-in (Easy Auth) on the new private address and its reply address on the sign-in app registration; then ingress on for the VNet
changes.scope: the PIM Manager and its sign-in app
changes.why: Without sign-in the PIM Manager stays on internal ingress.

changes.object: the private DNS zone for the new default domain (apex and wildcard to the static IP), linked to the PIM VNet and each -HubVnetId
changes.why: Clients in the VNet and the peered networks must resolve the new private address.

changes.object: public network access OFF (only with -LockRegistry; refused unless the registry is Premium with a private endpoint)
changes.scope: the registry in the resource group
changes.why: A private environment pulls images and builds over the private endpoint.
changes.undo: Turn public network access back on for the registry.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.help: A short label for the capture files (any short name).

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: The PIM subscription.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: The PIM resource group.

parameters.name: EnvName
parameters.help: The Container Apps environment.

parameters.name: ManagerApp
parameters.help: The PIM Manager app.

parameters.name: CaptureDir
parameters.help: Where the capture is written (and read from with -ResumeFromCapture).

parameters.name: EasyAuthTenantId
parameters.help: The tenant whose Entra ID signs users in to the PIM Manager. Without it (and no sign-in configured) the PIM Manager stays on internal ingress.

parameters.name: AzureConfigDir
parameters.help: Accepted for older callers and ignored: the rebuild uses no Azure CLI.

parameters.name: SkipEasyAuth
parameters.help: Attach no sign-in (the PIM Manager stays on internal ingress).

parameters.name: ResumeFromCapture
parameters.help: Continue a run that stopped after the delete, from the capture in -CaptureDir.

parameters.name: DeleteTimeoutSeconds
parameters.help: How long to wait for the environment delete.

parameters.name: SqlServer
parameters.help: The SQL server (FQDN), for the database-user repair and the Graph re-grant.

parameters.name: SqlDatabase
parameters.help: The database.

parameters.name: SqlAdminClientId
parameters.help: An identity in the SQL admin group used for the database-user repair (with -SqlAdminCertThumbprint).

parameters.name: SqlAdminClientSecret
parameters.help: Legacy only: a client secret for -SqlAdminClientId. Prefer -SqlAdminCertThumbprint.

parameters.name: SqlAdminCertThumbprint
parameters.help: The thumbprint of -SqlAdminClientId's certificate in the local certificate store.

parameters.name: SkipIdentityRepair
parameters.help: Do not repair the database users or the role assignments of the new identities.

parameters.name: EasyAuthAllowedPrincipals
parameters.help: Who may sign in to the PIM Manager (users or groups).

parameters.name: EasyAuthAllowAllTenantUsers
parameters.help: Every member account of the tenant may sign in (never guests).

parameters.name: HubVnetId
parameters.help: The hub VNet(s) the new private DNS zone is also linked to. Without it only the PIM VNet resolves the PIM Manager.

parameters.name: PrivateDnsResourceGroup
parameters.help: Where the new private DNS zone goes (same subscription; default the PIM resource group).

parameters.name: LockRegistry
parameters.help: Turn the registry's public network access off (refused unless Premium with a private endpoint).

parameters.name: HostingAccessTenantId
parameters.help: Re-grant the new identities' Microsoft Graph permissions and the Run-now right in this tenant (Initialize-PimHostingAccess.ps1), in your own session. Needs -SqlServer.

parameters.name: HostingAccessClientId
parameters.help: Optional: a certificate identity for that re-grant instead of your session.

parameters.name: HostingAccessCertThumbprint
parameters.help: Its certificate thumbprint in the local certificate store.

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Do it. Without it (and always with -WhatIf) the script prints the plan.

readsOnly: the Container Apps environment, the PIM Manager app (with its secrets and sign-in configuration) and every job
the data-bearing resources of the resource group -- recorded before and checked after
the system identities' Azure role assignments and application ids; the registry and SQL server's private endpoints
network: <server>.database.windows.net:1433 (only for the database-user repair and the Graph re-grant's one setting)
whatIf: Reads the live environment and prints the plan: 'direction : EXTERNAL -> INTERNAL-ONLY', the captured PIM Manager and jobs, the keep-list, then 'PLAN ONLY -- nothing was changed' with the would DELETE / CREATE ('--internal-only true') / RESTORE lines, the private DNS zone it would create, notes on the registry and SQL, and 'capture NOT written (-WhatIf)'. -WhatIf wins over -Apply. Nothing is deleted or created.
undo: Rebuild-PimEnvExternal.ps1 -Tag <tag> -SubscriptionId <subscription> -ResourceGroup <rg> -EasyAuthTenantId <tenant> -Apply rebuilds the environment public again. A run that stopped part-way resumes with -ResumeFromCapture -CaptureDir <the printed folder>. Data is never touched.
